review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen C input. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, DEC-001, task keys, repository identity and base commit agree with the original PRD. C explicitly fixes OPT-1 as a hypothetical benchmark input with humanConfirmed=false; it neither requires nor represents a registered human Decision. Only the selected branch is required. A materially unresolved DEC-001 in paired B must still block at decisions before later prerequisites. The supplied source shows that classic and mini delegate stringbool construction to core/api.ts, where normalization and truthy-first parsing currently occur, supporting construction-time overlap rejection within the exact three-file writable scope. The remaining forwarding, declaration-consumer and utility paths are appropriately inspection-only; the supplied build configuration supports treating emitted declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners. Boundary coverage, no additional trimming, compatibility, and separate runtime/type-check verification obligations are coherent. TASK-VERIFY is independent and depends on TASK-IMPLEMENT, with both relationships required to cover every mandatory AC. The allowed implementer and verifier have the relevant supplied active project-scoped trusted claims, including data.change, and the verifier additionally has testing.verification; eligibility need not rely on pending legacy claims or personas. A separate active, non-auto-assignable reviewer is configured as required by the supplied review policy. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and the provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation source digest domains and PRD whitespace normalization. Model, policy, sampling and budget identifiers are frozen consistently. Historical project reuse is explicitly isolated from this bundle and preserves scoped attestations without supplying candidate outputs. The original preparation remaining/runnable fields describe preparation lifecycle, not a contradiction of expected planning readiness. This approval concerns the independent expectation, not execution, task dispatch, human attestation, or release authorization. I reviewed only the supplied data, used no tools, executed no code, and did not independently recompute Service-calculated digests.
